Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella Explains Voluntary Exit Offers

Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella stated that the company's voluntary exit offer is intended to provide employees with greater career flexibility. He explained that this initiative is a response to AI and evolving business needs, which are reshaping jobs, skills, and workplace structures. Nadella indicated a desire to avoid employees feeling 'stuck' in their roles.
